prompt.en-US: Answer in three or four sentences.

question.zh-CN: 什么时候整体准确率会误导上线决策？举一个例子说明你会换成什么指标。
question.en-US: When does overall accuracy mislead a launch decision? Give an example and the metric you would use instead.

description.zh-CN: 指出类别不均衡时准确率被大类主导
description.en-US: Says accuracy is dominated by large classes under imbalance

description.zh-CN: 指出不同错误代价不同，指标要反映代价
description.en-US: Says errors cost differently and the metric should reflect cost

description.zh-CN: 给出具体替代指标（代价加权、关键类精确率/召回率等）
description.en-US: Names a concrete replacement (cost-weighted error, per-class precision/recall)

modelAnswer.zh-CN: 类别不均衡且错误代价不同的时候。比如分流模型 95% 的工单在两个大队列，准确率很高但退款错分率可能很差；我会用代价加权错误率，并单独报告退款队列的精确率。
modelAnswer.en-US: When classes are imbalanced and errors cost differently. A triage model with 95% of tickets in two big queues can score high accuracy while misrouting refunds; I would use cost-weighted error and report refund precision separately.

explanation.zh-CN: 指标是决策代价的代理。
explanation.en-US: A metric is a proxy for the decision's costs.
